_comment: Base costs ONLY — tunable data. The formulas that consume these (linear vs quadratic, and the resource free-floating premium) live in code in default-price-list.js. Edit the numbers here; do not add logic.
_actionBudgetNote: Runtime action costs charged against core's per-run budget ledger (NOT the authoring price list). core-ts enforces caps and emits limit events; these numbers are the Allocator's policy, injected via ports/budget.js. action_default applies to every action kind; specific kinds override it.
_levelAuthoringNote: Level-authoring economy knobs, moved out of commands/card-authoring.js by CR.1 — they were pricing policy sitting in glue, feeding calculateCardValue, card receipts, UI guidance and auto-generation. budget_split_percent must sum to 100. The reference budget is NOT here: it is REFERENCE_BUDGET_TOKENS in budget-allocation.js, which card-authoring duplicated as DEFAULT_LEVEL_BUDGET_TOKENS (both 2500) until CR.1 collapsed them.
_levelBudgetSplitNote: Per-card-type share of a level budget, as percentages summing to 100. Its own group because the base-cost standard requires every item to be a NUMBER — a nested object here would be formula selection in JSON, which the standard puts in code. RETUNED at CR.9 M5 (room 44->41, hazard 12->15): the old split was calibrated when a hazard cost 5 tokens with its affinity payload and vitals charged NOTHING. Those are charged now, so a hazard costs ~52 and three of them no longer fit a 12% share — content-gen scenario 51 failed on hazards 157/156. The share follows the prices, not the other way around. RETUNED AGAIN at the actor viability floor (room 41->29, delver 20->25, warden 16->23): the floor gives every actor health/mana/durability 10 with regen 1, so a delver's minimum went 21->52 and a warden's 4->38 while rooms and tiles did not move at all. Six constrained scenarios denied on the ACTOR pools with budget still remaining -- wardens short by up to 41% of their share. Wardens rose most because they started cheapest, which is why their share gains more than the delvers'.
